meta.title: Skull Darts 71 · Darts, fuzz and friendship
meta.description: Recreational darts association: friendly game nights and a community with a stoner and metal soundtrack. Calendar, sign-ups and messaging for members.
meta.ogDescription: Recreational darts association: friendly game nights with a stoner and metal soundtrack.
meta.noscript: The Skull Darts 71 website needs JavaScript to work.

landing.intro: A club where we aim true, play loud and gather around the board. Beginners welcome, champions tolerated.

fun.title: Just for fun
fun.text: A recreational association: we play to have fun, beginners and regulars alike, with no pressure and no rankings.

nights.title: Game nights
nights.text: Practice sessions, challenges and impromptu games, to a stoner and metal soundtrack.

community.title: Community
community.text: Messaging, a calendar and shared memories after every event.

cta.title: Ready to aim for 180?
cta.text: Create your account, pick a nickname and join the next game night.

friend.text: A band close to the club. Go check out their music and catch their next gigs.

song.subtitle: Skull Darts 71 anthem
song.mood: Stoner groove, warm fuzz, post-metal build-up, a chorus to sing with your glass raised.
song.credits: Lyrics and music: Skull Darts 71. Royalty-free for the club.
song.tabCaption: Main riff (tablature, low string at the bottom)
song.lyricsLanguage: Original lyrics in French, as sung by the club.
song.unsupported: Your browser does not support audio synthesis.
song.playerNote: Riff played live by your browser (Web Audio synthesis, nothing downloaded). Mind the volume!

intro: Fuzz bass alone on the riff, 4 bars
Drums come in: open hi-hat, then the whole band
solo: Wide-open wah over the C blues scale
Post-metal build-up: double-time drums, everyone in unison
outro: Sustained feedback on the low C
One last kick drum… and the sound of a dart hitting the bullseye
